question.text: A trade annulment request in the Exchange trading system must be submitted within what timeframe from the point of trade execution?

answer.text: Within 30 minutes from the point of trade execution
Within 1 hour from the point of trade execution
Before end of the trading day
Within 15 minutes from the point of trade execution

explanation.text: The Logic: The source states that trading members may submit a request for trade annulment on the trading system within 30 minutes from the point of trade execution. The Trap: 1 hour is the timeframe for reporting technical glitches to the exchange, not the trade annulment window. Trade annulment has a tighter 30-minute deadline. Note: Trade annulment requests are subject to conditions for further processing and an annulment application fee based on trade value (subject to a minimum and maximum).
